remix_prompt: City Builder. A satirical game inspired by Mario built around city builder play, with creative, cozy, satisfying energy, before bed session design, search-friendly hooks like city builder, building, tycoon, aesthetics like fairycore, decora kei, cottagecore, and meme-tone cues such as hello kitty, slay queen. Designed for one-thumb mobile play with touch-friendly interactions, responsive readability, fast onboarding, and portrait-first UX tuned for iOS and Android in the 4:7 to 9:16 range.
